purpose: Raster hero concepts for discovery; not an implemented UI

variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high fidelity PRYDD landing page HERO concept board for a design discussion, not a deployed website.
Input images: Image 1 is a symbol shape reference from the existing kit; preserve that small symbol silhouette. Image 2 is the user's intended Wise reference ONLY for oversized heavy tightly spaced uppercase headline hierarchy, compact pill buttons and confidence of composition. Do not copy Wise's logo, words or lime palette.
Create one landscape presentation image with a large desktop homepage first viewport on the left (about 75% width) and a tall phone-size homepage first viewport on the right (about 25% width). Flat front-facing UI, no tilted hardware, no browser chrome, no decorative scene. Neutral very pale gray board gutter and discreet board label "A / WHITE + BLUE". Both previews show the same design.
PRYDD desktop hero is an entire screen. Minimal navigation: supplied small black symbol with wordmark "PRYDD" at left; "How it works" near the right; pill "Join early access" at far right. Spell PRYDD P-R-Y-D-D exactly.
Main backdrop: off-white #FAFAF7. A very large spherical shell made of small rectangular photorealistic photographic tiles portraying diverse adults and everyday urban moments across countries. Use a spatial photo globe like Plasma's people-and-places globe, NOT an earth map or solid planet. The top, bottom and sides of the spherical shell reach the hero bounds. Vary tile sizes and foreshortening naturally with perspective, sparse and tiny at the back, recognisable a little larger at the rim. Maintain natural photographic colours and skin tones, no blue colour wash. Keep a very generous completely empty central opening for text, no photos behind words.
In that open centre set an oversized Montserrat ExtraBold-style geometric sans headline, uppercase, near black #17191D, centred, tight letter spacing and tight but legible line height. Exact wording "ONE APP FOR" on line one, "EVERYDAY" on line two, "GLOBAL MONEY." on line three. It must be the dominant element and retain the clean memorable scale of the supplied Wise headline. Below it a single short support sentence "Add money. Hold dollars. Send by username." Below that one electric blue #2457F5 pill button with white exact text "Join early access". Optional tiny downward scroll arrow along bottom; no other headline, claims, metrics or badges.
Phone view adapts the same design, with black PRYDD mark and menu at top, globe shell deliberately cropped at left and right, fewer photographic tiles visible, clear calm centre. Large bold headline with sensible same wording and readable line breaks; short support sentence and blue CTA fully visible within the phone's first viewport. The globe remains present on mobile. Use generous padding and strong contrast; no tiny unreadable navigation.
Constraints: same colours, font family, copy, globe composition principles between desktop and phone; no financial cards, balances, rates, currency flags, card-spending claims or extra content; no Wise or Plasma branding; no new logo design. This is a thoughtful composition for everyday global money, not science fiction. Keep all text crisp and verbatim.
